answer: Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The fable graph is validated at intake and the tundra frontier is published, and hence the ancestry of every answer is public, and lagoon anchors the chain at a checkpoint. An attacker who wants 24 percent of the vote must hold 36 percent of the bonded float for 38 days, which is capital that earns nothing while it waits. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
